children: Saudi Arabia's energy minister signed three memorandums of understanding with Kuwait, Qatar and Egypt to strengthen energy cooperation, the Saudi state news agency said on Sunday.
The agreement with Qatar sets a framework for collaboration in petroleum, natural gas and petrochemicals, including exploring joint opportunities to develop pipelines for transport and exports.
